title: Reckoner's Arena activating Yone's conquer effect
explanation: Reckoner's Arena checks the specified unit conquer effects as if a conquer occurred, but no actual conquer occurs. Yone's additional 'previously uncontrolled' condition is still checked and fails when the Arena was already controlled.
